title: Zscaler product portfolio: which product serves each customer need

prose.text: Each customer need below names the product that serves it and links that product's entry subject. Portfolio-level subjects follow the products.

items.text: Internet and SaaS access, URL filtering and SSL inspection: [[zia.url-filtering]] (ZIA).
Private application access without a VPN: [[zpa.app-segments]] (ZPA).
The endpoint agent that forwards user traffic: [[zcc.app-profiles]] (ZCC), with device posture in [[zcc.device-posture]].
Cloud and branch workload traffic forwarding: [[cloud-connector.overview]] (Cloud & Branch Connector).
Isolation of risky browsing in a remote browser: [[zbi.cloud-browser]] (ZBI, Zero Trust Browser).
Branch SD-WAN and agentless device segmentation: [[zero-trust-branch.overview]] (Zero Trust Branch).
East-west segmentation of workloads: [[zms.overview]] (ZMS).
Cellular connectivity for IoT and OT devices: [[zscaler-cellular.overview]] (Zscaler Cellular).
Identity, OAuth API clients and admin access: [[zidentity.overview]] (ZIdentity).
Identity threat detection on endpoints and directories: [[identity-protection.overview]] (Identity Protection, ITDR).
Digital experience monitoring: [[zdx.overview]] (ZDX).
A single admin console across products: [[unified.overview]] (Experience Center).
Runtime policy for AI and LLM applications, and the AI Security family: [[ai-security.family]] (AI Guard, AI Red Teaming).
Data at rest: discovery and posture of stored data: [[dspm.overview]] (DSPM).
Inline and out-of-band CASB, which is more than one product: [[portfolio.casb]].
Shadow IT and SaaS application risk reporting: [[portfolio.saas-security-report]] (formerly ZINS).
Microsoft Copilot oversharing and data controls: [[portfolio.copilot-data-protection]].
DLP incident workflow and ticketing: [[zwa.incidents]] (ZWA, Workflow Automation).
SaaS usage, spend and workplace analytics: [[business-insights.overview]] (Business Insights).
Outside-in discovery of internet-facing assets: [[easm.findings]] (EASM).
Asset inventory and coverage gaps: [[aem.overview]] (AEM).
Vulnerability prioritization: [[uvm.overview]] (UVM).
Cyber risk quantification: [[risk360.overview]] (Risk360).
Active-defense decoys: [[deception.overview]] (Zscaler Deception).
Alert consolidation into incidents: [[soc-workbench.overview]] (SOC Workbench).
Forecasting where a breach may move next: [[breach-predictor.overview]] (Breach Predictor).
The SecOps suite, Red Canary MDR, managed threat hunting and CTEM: [[portfolio.security-operations]].
Cloud protection and posture (CNAPP), where the captures are thin: [[portfolio.cloud-protection]].
Failure tiers from minor failures to catastrophic events: [[portfolio.resilience]].
Business Continuity Cloud components and constraints: [[portfolio.business-continuity-cloud]].
Zero Trust Exchange for B2B: [[portfolio.b2b]].
Government cloud editions and certifications: [[portfolio.federal-clouds]].
The platform pillars, Data Fabric for Security and Agentic SecOps: [[portfolio.platform]].
